name: General Assistant
description: Default blueprint for general conversational tasks, information retrieval, and multi-modal assistance

steps.description: Decide which modalities (text, image, audio, video, code, math, ...) the request and any attachments involve. Consumes the raw request and attachments. Hands on the list of detected modalities; an empty list is a valid answer (the later steps then run without modality-specific handling). Legacy design branched: with modalities -> create per-modality graphs, without -> go straight to context.
steps.name: detect_modalities

steps.description: Write the response to the request. Consumes the request, the detected modalities from the previous step and the aggregated context the walk supplies (ZSEI semantic context and the per-modality graphs). Hands on the response text.
steps.name: generate_response

steps.description: Format the response for the user (structure, readability, references to the modality material it relies on) and state which session/graph context it relates to. Consumes the response and the modality graphs; hands on the final response. (The session-graph update itself is done by the walk, Stage 4.)
steps.name: format_and_return

walk_covered.covered_by: walk intake (Stage 0-2: request received, jurisdiction gate, text normalization)
walk Stage 4 (graph creation: per-modality structural graphs, links and updates are made by the walk)
walk Stages 3-5 (context aggregation: methodologies, graphs and the AMT are assembled into each step's prompt)

2.name: detect_modalities
2.legacy_description: Auto-detect modalities from request and attachments

3.name: process_modalities
3.legacy_description: Create structural graphs for detected modalities

4.name: build_context
4.legacy_description: Aggregate context from ZSEI and modality graphs

6.name: format_and_return
6.legacy_description: Format response and update session graph
